blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The newly convened first elected Bangsamoro Parliament has set its target legislation for the next 100 days. Deputy Majority Floor Leader Naguib Sinarimbo, a lawyer, said the Parliament will focus its attention on enacting the proposed revenue code and the 2027 regional budget. The revenue code was one of the major pieces of legislation left unpassed by the former Bangsamoro Transition Authority, whose mandate ended last Oct. 30 with the convening of the elected Members of Parliament. The parliament also plans to revive the Intergovernmental Relations Body and establish the Philippine Congress-Bangsamoro Parliament Forum, he added. READ: Marcos […]...
